capabilities: Manages literature in a matrix with summary notes and category-colored tags
Runs concurrent AI summaries with inline stage progress
Opens a Research Weaver sidebar panel
Creates and edits chemical structures with a bundled Ketcher editor
extras: Release candidate not accepted by the Obsidian Community Plugin Directory; requires desktop Obsidian 1.10.0+; upgrade/rollback procedures are unvalidated acceptance tests; keep data.json on upgrade (may hold credentials) and test in a disposable vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in literature management, AI-assisted research workflows, or experiment records, so scholars must stitch together separate tools.

relations.evidence: statically bundles the graphical Ketcher editor

summary: Local-first scholarly workspace combining literature management, AI summaries, notes, experiment records, and a Research Weaver sidebar panel.
